items.mainDefect: request.referer is interpolated into a JS string literal in the embed layout without JS escaping, enabling XSS.

secondary.defect: The full referer URL (with path) is passed as the postMessage targetOrigin, which must be a bare origin, so the browser drops the resize message.

items.mainDefect: PollFeed has no error handling around open(feed_polling_url) and the SimpleRSS parse, so network errors or bad RSS crash the scheduled job.

secondary.defect: i.content can be nil, so CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub) raises NoMethodError and stops the feed import.

items.mainDefect: TopicEmbed.import_remote calls open(url).read with no error handling, so network errors crash the RetrieveTopic job.

secondary.defect: Readability can return a nil title or content, and import then calls contents << on nil, which raises NoMethodError.

items.mainDefect: The invalid-host examples in the TopicRetriever spec don't stub retrieved_recently? to false, so they may test the throttle branch instead of the host check.

secondary.defect: The $redis setnx/expire calls aren't cleared or mocked, so state can leak between tests.
